subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar criticamente o histórico e o discurso político de candidatos, propagandas políticas, políticas públicas, programas e propostas de governo, de forma a participar do debate político e tomar decisões conscientes e fundamentadas.

components.description_pt: Analisar o histórico político e discurso público de candidatos eleitorais
components.description_en: Analyze the political history and public discourse of electoral candidates
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the purposes and arguments in works of public advocacy such as The Federalist Papers

components.description_pt: Avaliar estratégias retóricas usadas em publicidades políticas e materiais de campanha
components.description_en: Evaluate the rhetorical strategies used in political advertisements and campaign materials
components.cc_component_description: Analyze a speaker's use of rhetorical strategies to persuade an audience

components.description_pt: Avaliar objetivos, alcance e eficácia de políticas públicas e propostas governamentais
components.description_en: Assess the goals, scope, and effectiveness of public policies and government proposals
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the purposes and arguments in works of public advocacy such as The Federalist Papers

components.description_pt: Formular posições bem fundamentadas para participar de debate político informado
components.description_en: Formulate well-grounded positions to participate in informed political debate
components.cc_component_description: Debate competing perspectives by connecting claims with reasons and evidence

cc_matches.description: Apply grades 11—12 Reading standards to literary nonfiction (e.g., "Delineate and evaluate the reasoning in seminal U.S. texts, including the application of constitutional principles and use of legal reasoning [e.g., in U.S. Supreme Court Case majority opinions and dissents] and the premises, purposes, and arguments in works of public advocacy [e.g., The Federalist, presidential addresses]").

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interactuar con otros (personas y medios) sobre argumentos para...
* intercambiar información relevante para respaldar afirmaciones con
evidencias recopiladas de múltiples fuentes
* debatir perspectivas
* conectar afirmaciones con razones y opiniones
* defender los temas y propósitos de una posición
* determinar una perspectiva común en las afirmaciones y evidencia de propuestas
Evaluate a speaker's point of view, reasoning, and use of evidence and rhetoric, identifying any fallacious reasoning or exaggerated or distorted evidence.
